C0984.title: Game for Peace Spectator Wallhack Crackdown Announcement
C0984.summary: On February 20, 2020, Game for Peace issued a notice targeting the exploit where low-ranked alternate accounts use wallhacks to spectate high-ranked main accounts. The official spectator system was upgraded to block this behavior, with support for automated detection and offline delayed bans.
